CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Mixed results - the primary endpoint RFS missed significance (HR 0.75, p=0.07) but overall survival showed benefit (HR 0.54, p=0.05). The pCR endpoint strongly hit. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported suggesting differential response patterns. 5. CONFOUNDERS: No major trial design issues - adequate sample size, appropriate comparator, reasonable duration. This represents a case where the mechanism worked biologically but didn't fully translate to the primary clinical endpoint, though secondary endpoints were positive.
